title: An imported part with no bin location goes to the Unassigned bin
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Loc Bins), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete', See Financial Data, the Data Import setting and the Parts settings.
  • {Location-A} has no bin location named "Unassigned" in Settings → Bin Locations.
  • No part or Part Library entry has the number {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-UNASSIGNED-01) or {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-UNASSIGNED-02) in any upper and lower case or punctuation.
  • Import file {File-A} (for example ZZ-PL-UNASSIGNED.csv) holds two rows that add {Part-A} and {Part-B}, each with quantity 0 and an empty Bin Location.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings → Data Import → Inventory.
  2. Upload {File-A}.
  3. Run the import.
  4. Go to Settings → Bin Locations.
  5. Go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
  6. Click the {Part-A} row.
  7. Click Cancel.
  8. Type {Part-B} in the search.
  9. Click the {Part-B} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the import finishes and adds both parts.
  • Step 4: the list now holds exactly one bin location named "Unassigned" (0 before + 1 created by the import = 1, used by both parts).
  • Step 5: one row, {Part-A}, whose Bin Location / Quantity column shows Unassigned with quantity 0.
  • Step 6: the Inventory section of the window shows one bin row: Bin Location "Unassigned", Quantity 0, marked Default.
  • Step 9: {Part-B} also shows one bin row: Bin Location "Unassigned", Quantity 0, marked Default.
